content.title: Trading and banking holidays
content.text: All CollectionsInvestInvest account managementTrading and banking holidays Updated over 2 months agoM1 follows the schedule of U.S. financial markets and banks for holiday closures. This guide explains when trading and banking services are unavailable due to holidays, how these dates can affect your transactions, and where to find more information. Trading holidays M1 only places trades when the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) is open. There are no trades on official NYSE holidays. On days the market closes early, M1 places trades only during the morning window. Trading holidays for upcoming years: Early Market Closures: ** Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 28, 2025, Friday, November 27, 2026, and Friday, November 26, 2027 (the day after Thanksgiving). NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time. *** Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Wednesday, December 24, 2025, and Thursday, December 24, 2026. NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time. Banking holidays M1 banking services (such as transfers, deposits, and withdrawals) follow the Federal Reserve System holiday calendar. Transactions requested on a banking holiday will process the next business day.
